description: Use this when the person wants to know what is on one of their palimpalem websites before changing it. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Returns status, plan, the list of pages, languages, the last saved versions and an outline of one page with element ids (sections, titles, texts, photos), which editar_web can target. Read only.

page.description: Optional. Which page to outline: its name from the page list (e.g. "menu") or its address. Without it, the home page.

web.description: The website: its name (e.g. panaderia-ruzafa), its address (panaderia-ruzafa.palimpalem.com) or its own domain.

name: ver_mi_web
title: Look at my website
